# wanaku.ai

> The Wanaku MCP Router extends AI workflows, delivers unmatched speed and reliability. Meet Wanaku, the open-source MCP Router that acts like a friendly, efficient receptionist for your digital office.

Important notes:
- The Wanaku MCP Router is a router for AI-enabled applications powered by the [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/).
- Wanaku is built on Rust and the Praxis proxy framework, providing a high-performance composable filter pipeline.
- Wanaku Barn is the Java/Quarkus-based MCP Router built on [Apache Camel](https://camel.apache.org), offering mature enterprise integrations.

The project name comes from the origins of the word [Guanaco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guanaco), a camelid native to
South America.

## Core Content
- [Documentation](https://wanaku.ai/docs/): Guides, API reference, demos, and SDK docs
- [Project Organization](https://github.com/wanaku-ai/): GitHub organization with all Wanaku repositories
- [Wanaku MCP Router](https://github.com/wanaku-ai/wanaku): Source code for the Rust-based Wanaku MCP Router
- [Wanaku Barn](https://github.com/wanaku-ai/wanaku-barn): Source code for the Java/Quarkus-based Wanaku Barn MCP Router
- [Wanaku Releases](https://github.com/wanaku-ai/wanaku/releases): Wanaku releases for download
- [Project Examples](https://github.com/wanaku-ai/wanaku-examples): Example configurations and integrations
